title: Be thankful that it’s not a subscription in 2025
body: It works great! And I only paid once, so I was instantly satisfied
author: Juancelio

title: Minimalistic yet beautiful
body:
I had been trying many habit-tracking apps until I discovered Streaks. Most of them were either unattractive or overly complicated. Streaks strikes a great balance between functionality and an eye-pleasing design.
I use it on all my devices: Mac, iPad, and iPhone. I can't believe it doesn't require a subscription!
author: Evgen O.

title: Amazing app
body: Great app, absolutely delivers on the promised features. Many thanks for giving an ability to just buy it once
